title: Motion on strengthening Singapore's economic competitiveness as a globally connected aviation, maritime and logistics hub
what_it_is: A Motion moved by the Chairperson of the Government Parliamentary Committee for Transport, Ms Tin Pei Ling, affirming the importance of strengthening Singapore's long-term economic competitiveness through international cooperation, frontier technologies and world-class infrastructure, debated by Members and resolved by the House.
why_it_matters: The transcript sets out concrete measures: MOT plans to invest $800 million over the next five years on transport research and innovation, and a manpower transition package for taxi and private-hire drivers includes place-and-train Career Conversion Programmes launching in the third quarter of this year, a $20-per-hour training incentive from January 2027, and a one-stop information webpage. Autonomous shuttles already run in Punggol and autonomous buses will be piloted on Service 400 in Marina Bay and Service 191 in One-North.

key_points.point: Ms Tin Pei Ling moved the Motion affirming the importance of strengthening Singapore's long-term economic competitiveness through international cooperation, frontier technologies and world-class infrastructure.
key_points.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (Marine Parade-Braddell Heights)
key_points.quote: That this House affirms the importance of strengthening Singapore's long-term economic competitiveness by leveraging international cooperation, frontier technologies and world-class infrastructure

key_points.point: She said day-to-day land transport issues remain a priority for the Transport GPC but are not the focus of this debate.
key_points.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (Marine Parade-Braddell Heights)
key_points.quote: Day-to-day land transport issues remain important and a priority to the Transport GPC. But they are not the focus of today's debate.

key_points.point: She declared an interest as co-president of a group that includes a deep-tech company developing next-generation energy systems.
key_points.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (Marine Parade-Braddell Heights)
key_points.quote: I declare my interest here as co-president of a group that includes a deep-tech company developing next-generation energy systems.

key_points.point: She called on the Ministry of Transport to increase research and development into AI applications and AI governance across land, sea and air transport.
key_points.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (Marine Parade-Braddell Heights)
key_points.quote: beef up on research and development (R&D) into AI applications and AI governance across land, sea and air transport

key_points.point: She called for linking the maritime, airport and land network digital twins into one Singapore transport twin.
key_points.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (Marine Parade-Braddell Heights)
key_points.quote: Third, work towards one Singapore transport twin.

key_points.point: She called for an ASEAN digital backbone for transport and an ASEAN data lake house for secure access to verifiable data.
key_points.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (Marine Parade-Braddell Heights)
key_points.quote: Second, build an ASEAN digital backbone for transport, an ASEAN data lake house that allows verifiable data to be accessed securely

key_points.point: She called for expanding career conversion and transition programmes and other SkillsFuture programmes with updated tracks for future transport jobs.
key_points.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (Marine Parade-Braddell Heights)
key_points.quote: expand existing career conversion and transition programmes as well as other SkillsFuture programmes to include updated and specialised tracks that meet the demands of future transport

key_points.point: Mr Dennis Tan declared that he is a consultant in a law firm which services maritime and logistics businesses.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
key_points.quote: I declare that I am a consultant in a law firm which services maritime and logistics businesses.

key_points.point: He said Singapore risks becoming a low-margin highway if it remains only an adopter of foreign technology.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
key_points.quote: If Singapore remains content with being an exceptional adopter of foreign technology, we risk becoming a low margin highway.

key_points.point: He proposed shifting innovation funding towards deep tech software and intellectual property.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
key_points.quote: One, shift innovation funding to deep tech software and intellectual property.

key_points.point: He proposed exploring a national transport data trust to let operators share anonymised operational data under common standards.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
key_points.quote: We should therefore explore establishing a national transport data trust

key_points.point: He proposed broadening global talent rotation to tech native tracks for local software engineers and data scientists.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
key_points.quote: Three, broaden global talent rotation to tech native tracks.

key_points.point: He said fewer young Singaporeans choosing seafaring careers has created structural pressure on the supply of local mariners.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
key_points.quote: the supply of local Singaporean mariners has faced structural pressures as fewer young Singaporeans choose seafaring careers

key_points.point: He called on MOT and MPA to enhance existing frameworks such as the Tripartite Maritime Training Award.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
key_points.quote: I call on MOT and MPA to significantly enhance our existing frameworks, such as the Tripartite Maritime Training Award.

key_points.point: He said the Government's decision to postpone the sustainable aviation fuel levy to January 2027 gives airlines greater flexibility.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
key_points.quote: the Government's decision to postpone the implementation of the sustainable aviation fuel levy to January 2027 provides airlines with greater flexibility

key_points.point: Mr Jackson Lam said Singapore should become the world's smartest transport hub through AI and data.
key_points.speaker: Mr Jackson Lam (Nee Soon)
key_points.quote: First, we must become the world's smartest transport hub through AI and data.

key_points.point: He said Singapore should aspire to be a transport innovation hub where innovations are tested, refined and commercialised.
key_points.speaker: Mr Jackson Lam (Nee Soon)
key_points.quote: Second, Singapore should aspire not only to be a transport hub, but also a transport innovation hub.

key_points.point: Ms He Ting Ru asked the Minister to clarify progress on SGTraDex against the Government's declared adoption and value creation metrics.
key_points.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: Could the Minister thus clarify what progress have been made in terms of working towards the Government's declared adoption and value creation metrics

key_points.point: She asked for the specific risk frameworks and contingency plans that would keep Singapore connected if key maritime, aviation, digital or energy supply routes are disrupted.
key_points.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: Could the Minister clarify the specific risk frameworks and contingency plans that would keep Singapore connected if key maritime, aviation, digital or energy supply routes are disrupted

key_points.point: She said shipping, maritime, aviation and related industries account for around 12% of Singapore's GDP.
key_points.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
key_points.quote: shipping, maritime, aviation and related industries account for around 12% of Singapore's GDP

key_points.point: Mr Baey Yam Keng said MOT plans to invest $800 million over the next five years on transport research and innovation.
key_points.speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
key_points.quote: MOT plans to invest $800 million over the next five years on transport research and innovation

key_points.point: He said approximately two-thirds of the $800 million will be directed towards cross-cutting capabilities in autonomy and digital twins.
key_points.speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
key_points.quote: we will invest $800 million to support research in transport and connectivity, with approximately two-thirds directed towards cross-cutting capabilities in autonomy and digital twins

key_points.point: He cited the Sea Transport Industry Digital Plan as a roadmap guiding maritime SMEs in adopting digital solutions.
key_points.speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
key_points.quote: the Sea Transport Industry Digital Plan provides a clear roadmap to guide maritime SMEs in adopting digital solutions

key_points.point: Ms Sun Xueling said she launched the $200 million OneAviation Manpower Fund last July to support employers, unions and workers.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: Last July, I launched the $200 million OneAviation Manpower Fund to support employers, unions and workers.

key_points.point: She said the Sail Milestone Achievement Programme provides up to $50,000 for local seafarers.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: The Sail Milestone Achievement Programme provides up to $50,000 for local seafarers.

key_points.point: She said the Career Conversion Programme for the Sea Transport sector reskilled close to 200 mid-career entrants and existing employees last year.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: the Career Conversion Programme for the Sea Transport sector reskilled close to 200 mid-career entrants and existing employees last year

key_points.point: She said Grab and ComfortDelGro currently operate 16 fixed route autonomous shuttles in Punggol.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: Grab and ComfortDelGro currently operate 16 fixed route autonomous shuttles in Punggol.

key_points.point: She said autonomous buses will be piloted on Service 400 in Marina Bay and Service 191 in One-North.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: We will begin piloting autonomous buses on two public bus services, Service 400 in Marina Bay and Service 191 in One-North.

key_points.point: She said a new training incentive scheme will be piloted from January 2027, giving eligible drivers $20 per hour for up to 80 hours of training.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: eligible drivers will get a training incentive of $20 per hour for attending any of over 2,000 curated SWDA-supported courses, up to a cap of 80 hours of training

key_points.point: She said place-and-train Career Conversion Programmes for drivers will be launched in the third quarter of this year.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: The CCPs will be launched in third quarter of this year.

key_points.point: She said the Government is studying how to enable seamless air-sea transfers between Changi Airport and Tanah Merah Ferry Terminal.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: we are studying how to best enable seamless air-sea transfers between Changi Airport and Tanah Merah Ferry Terminal

key_points.point: She said Singapore remains open to discussing new proposals with Malaysia on the Kuala Lumpur-Singapore HSR from a clean slate.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: We remain open to discussing new proposals with Malaysia in good faith, starting from a clean slate.

key_points.point: She said the goal is to start with a 1% sustainable aviation fuel uplift, rising to 3% to 5% by 2030.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: Our goal is to start with a 1% sustainability aviation fuel uplift, rising to 3% to 5% by 2030

key_points.point: She said registrations of electric heavy vehicles rose from less than 1% last year to around 20% as of May this year.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: registrations of electric heavy vehicles rose from less than 1% of all heavy vehicle registrations last year to around 20% as of May this year

key_points.point: She said the use of autonomy and AI will be rolled out at a pace acceptable to residents, commuters and drivers.
key_points.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling)
key_points.quote: We will roll out the use of autonomy and AI at a pace acceptable to residents, commuters and drivers.

key_points.point: In her closing speech, Ms Tin Pei Ling said attending to everyday public transport issues and building for Singapore's global connectivity and future are not competing priorities.
key_points.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (Marine Parade-Braddell Heights)
key_points.quote: Attending to the everyday public transport issues and building for Singapore's global connectivity and future are not competing priorities.

key_points.point: The House resolved the Motion affirming the importance of strengthening Singapore's long-term economic competitiveness through international cooperation, frontier technologies and world-class infrastructure.
key_points.speaker: Mr Speaker
key_points.quote: That this House affirms the importance of strengthening Singapore’s long-term economic competitiveness by leveraging international cooperation, frontier technologies and world-class infrastructure

what_happens_next: The Motion was resolved by the House; no further step is stated in the transcript.
